corrected: Local uniformization on algebraic surfaces over ground fields of characteristic  $p \neq 0$ , Ann. of Math., t. 63, no. 3, 1956, p. 491--526.
note: The cited paper is S. Abhyankar, 'Local uniformization on algebraic surfaces over ground fields of characteristic p ≠ 0', Ann. of Math. 63 (1956), no. 3, 491–526: surfaces in positive characteristic, which is why Théorème 2.3.1 (p. 27) cites [1] for dim X = 2 and [2] (Hironaka) for characteristic zero. The print has 'of' for 'on', 'field' for 'fields', 'p = 0' (no stroke through the = in the scan or in the DjVu witness) and the wrong journal (the volume and year are the Annals ones). The TeX keeps the printed reading; the corrected layer (expose_II_body.tex) already reads 'Local uniformization on algebraic surfaces over ground fields of characteristic  $p \neq 0$ , Ann. of Math., t. 63, no. 3, 1956, p. 491--526.' 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.
